shifts.name: Department of Impossible Vehicles
shifts.intro: Rooftops are not a public right. Even for creatures who can fly.
shifts.memo: Being able to land somewhere does not constitute permission to land there.
shifts.briefing: Your first assignment is rooftop parking. Expect large vehicles, larger egos, and fireproofing certificates. The regulations are on your left. Please familiarise yourself with them before anything lands.

rules.title: Respect the roof.
rules.description: Declared weight must be 2,000 kg or less.

rules.title: Check the coverage.
rules.description: The authorised zones must include Rooftop. Ground permission alone is insufficient.

rules.title: Fireproofing is mandatory.
rules.description: The fireproofing certificate must be valid on the office date shown above.

applications.name: Aurelia Cinder
applications.quote: The roof was there. I was there. It seemed an excellent arrangement.

applications.name: Percival Drift
applications.quote: I weighed myself before breakfast. Clouds do not have especially heavy breakfasts.

applications.name: Matilda Brass
applications.quote: The chimney is a decorative feature. Mostly.

applications.name: Orson Featherwick
applications.quote: I promise to leave no feathers. I cannot speak for my passengers.

applications.name: Beatrice Hush
applications.quote: The view is quite lovely, and the lift does not accommodate my upholstery.

applications.name: Felix Ember
applications.quote: I inspect chimneys. Naturally, I should be near one.

applications.name: Hector Bellweather
applications.quote: I am considerably lighter when nobody is looking.

applications.name: Juniper Vale
applications.quote: The books weigh more than the broom, but I have declared both.

shifts.name: Department of Inconvenient Travel
shifts.intro: Arriving instantly still requires advance permission.
shifts.memo: A destination that sounds approximately correct is not an authorised destination.
shifts.briefing: Today you will process temporary teleportation requests. Please note that the Moon remains outside our service area. The authorised destinations and luggage limit are printed in the rulebook.

rules.title: Stay inside the service area.
rules.description: Only Old Town, Railway Station, and Post Office are authorised destinations.

rules.title: Pack sensibly.
rules.description: Declared luggage must be 40 kg or less. This includes emotional baggage if packed.

rules.title: Travel on a valid certificate.
rules.description: The travel certificate must be valid on the office date shown above.

applications.name: Edmund Elsewhere
applications.quote: The lecture begins in three minutes. I was meant to leave yesterday.

applications.name: Nora Pocket
applications.quote: I am transporting only the essential stamps. All forty kilograms of them.

applications.name: Silas Moonsworth
applications.quote: The Moon is technically above the town. Surely that counts.

applications.name: Viola Trunk
applications.quote: The coffin is carry-on. The piano is also carry-on.

applications.name: Basil Yesterday
applications.quote: My certificate was valid at the time I completed the application.

applications.name: Clementine Fold
applications.quote: I have folded my suitcase to meet your requirements.

applications.name: Dorian Approximate
applications.quote: The Oldest Town must surely be older than Old Town. It should qualify.

applications.name: Rosalind Finch
applications.quote: Please ensure the pigeons do not arrive with me this time.

shifts.name: Department of After-Hours Phenomena
shifts.intro: The living have rights. So do the neighbours.
shifts.memo: A heartfelt moan remains a noise. Please measure it accordingly.
shifts.briefing: Your final assignment is residential haunting. Four regulations now apply. Check the start time carefully: our permitted window crosses midnight, from 22:00 through 05:00. Being deceased does not exempt applicants from obtaining consent.

rules.title: Observe haunting hours.
rules.description: The start time must be between 22:00 and 05:00, inclusive. The window crosses midnight.

rules.title: Keep the moaning down.
rules.description: Declared noise must be 30 dB or less. Chains count.

rules.title: Obtain consent.
rules.description: The property owner must have provided consent. A frightened nod does not count.

rules.title: Do not overstay.
rules.description: The requested haunting must last 60 minutes or less.

applications.name: Agnes Rattle
applications.quote: I shall haunt in a whisper. The books deserve a quiet evening.

applications.name: Mortimer Clank
applications.quote: The chains are part of my cultural heritage.

applications.name: Lydia Dawn
applications.quote: The morning light is simply better for appearing in mirrors.

applications.name: Rupert Uninvited
applications.quote: Nobody explicitly asked me to leave. I consider that very encouraging.

applications.name: Eveline Still
applications.quote: I have written down the exact limits. I intend to meet them.

applications.name: Oswald Echo
applications.quote: One hour is barely enough time to get into the atmosphere.

applications.name: Cora Candlewick
applications.quote: I will extinguish the candles before I leave. I am not unreasonable.

applications.name: Ambrose Excess
applications.quote: If one rattling cupboard is unsettling, imagine twelve.
